speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: Saya demam sejak malam tadi, dan pagi tadi suhu badan saya 38.5 darjah.

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: Hidung saya asyik berair dan saya tidak boleh berhenti bersin, terutamanya pada waktu pagi.
translator_notes: 'asyik berair' = keeps running.

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: Tekak saya sangat sakit dan terasa sakit bila saya menelan makanan, malah air pun.

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: Saya sudah batuk selama lebih kurang dua minggu, dan kadang-kadang ada kahak kuning.

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: Seluruh badan saya sakit-sakit, saya rasa sangat letih, dan saya asyik rasa seram sejuk.
translator_notes: 'seram sejuk' = everyday term for chills.

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: Adakah anda perasan sebarang ruam, gusi berdarah, atau sakit di belakang mata?

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: Saya sakit kepala hampir setiap petang, dan ubat tahan sakit hanya membantu selama beberapa jam.
translator_notes: 'ubat tahan sakit' = painkillers.

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: Saya sudah cirit-birit lima kali sejak pagi tadi, dan saya juga rasa mahu muntah.

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: Minum banyak air dan garam rehidrasi oral, dan elakkan makanan yang berminyak atau pedas selama beberapa hari.
translator_notes: 'garam rehidrasi oral' is the standard MOH term for ORS.

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translation: Saya rasa sakit pedih di bahagian atas perut, dan ia bertambah teruk bila saya lapar.
translator_notes: 'pedih' = burning/stinging.

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: Ada ruam merah yang gatal di lengan saya, dan ia bermula selepas saya tukar sabun.

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: Pinggang saya tercedera semasa saya mengangkat kotak yang berat di tempat kerja, dan sekarang saya tidak boleh membongkok.
translator_notes: 'pinggang' is the everyday Malay word for the lower back.

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: Saya rasa pening bila saya berdiri dengan cepat, dan kadang-kadang semuanya mula berpusing.

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: Saya rasa ketat di dada, dan ia merebak ke lengan kiri saya bila saya berjalan.

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: Ini mungkin serius, jadi saya akan hantar anda ke jabatan kecemasan sekarang juga.

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: Asma saya semakin teruk pada waktu malam, dan inhaler saya nampaknya tidak berkesan seperti biasa.
translator_notes: 'inhaler' kept as common loanword (formal: penyedut).

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: Terasa pedih bila saya buang air kecil, dan saya sangat kerap perlu pergi ke tandas.
translator_notes: 'buang air kecil' = pass urine (polite everyday).

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: Mata saya merah dan berair sejak tiga hari lalu, dan melekit bila saya bangun tidur.

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: Anak lelaki saya sakit di telinga kanan, dan dia menangis dan menarik-narik telinganya sepanjang malam.
translator_notes: 'menarik-narik' = repeated pulling.

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: Ibu jari kaki saya bengkak dan sangat sakit, dan saya tidak boleh pakai kasut pun.
translator_notes: 'ibu jari kaki' = big toe.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translation: Gula dalam darah anda masih agak tinggi, jadi kita perlu tambah ubat kencing manis anda.
translator_notes: 'kencing manis' is the everyday word for diabetes.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: Tekanan darah anda hari ini 160 per 95, dan itu lebih tinggi daripada yang sepatutnya.
translator_notes: 'per' is how 'over' is read aloud for BP.

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: Sila jangan makan atau minum apa-apa kecuali air kosong selama 10 jam sebelum ujian darah anda.
translator_notes: 'air kosong' = plain water.

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: Adakah saya perlu makan ubat kolesterol seumur hidup, atau bolehkah saya berhenti bila sudah normal?
translator_notes: 'makan ubat' is the everyday phrasing for taking medicine.

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: Adakah anda alah kepada apa-apa ubat, seperti penisilin atau aspirin?
translator_notes: Malay spelling 'penisilin'.

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: Ambil satu biji tablet tiga kali sehari selepas makan, dan habiskan semua ubat antibiotik.
translator_notes: 'course of antibiotics' rendered as finishing all the antibiotics, as said aloud.

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: Ubat ini mungkin buat anda rasa mengantuk, jadi jangan memandu atau mengendalikan mesin selepas makan ubat ini.
translator_notes: 'mesin' preferred over formal 'jentera'.

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translation: Bolehkah saya makan ubat ini bersama dengan ubat darah tinggi saya?
translator_notes: 'ubat darah tinggi' is the everyday term for blood pressure pills.

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: Boleh doktor beri saya sijil cuti sakit untuk dua hari? Majikan saya memerlukannya.
translator_notes: 'sijil cuti sakit' = medical certificate (MC); patient addresses the doctor as 'doktor'.

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: Saya mengandung 20 minggu. Adakah selamat untuk saya ambil vaksin selesema?
translator_notes: Malay has no grammatical gender; 'mengandung' is the everyday word for pregnant.

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: Ubat biasa saya sudah hampir habis. Bolehkah saya ambil ubat lagi tanpa berjumpa doktor?
translator_notes: 'refill' rendered as 'ambil ubat lagi' (get more medicine).

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: Kalau demam tidak turun dalam tiga hari atau anda rasa lebih teruk, sila datang semula dengan segera.

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: Saya akan rujuk anda ke hospital untuk X-ray dan pemeriksaan oleh pakar bagi lutut anda.
translator_notes: 'X-ray' is the common spoken term (formal 'sinar-X').

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: Sudah sebulan saya tidak dapat tidur dengan nyenyak, dan saya rasa tertekan dan cemas sepanjang masa.

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.
translation: Cuba kurangkan gula dan garam, dan bersenam sekurang-kurangnya 30 minit hampir setiap hari.
translator_notes: 'most days' rendered as 'hampir setiap hari'.

speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: நேற்று இரவிலிருந்து எனக்குக் காய்ச்சல் இருக்கிறது, இன்று காலை என் உடல் வெப்பநிலை 38.5 டிகிரி இருந்தது.

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: என் மூக்கு தொடர்ந்து ஒழுகிக்கொண்டே இருக்கிறது, தும்மலையும் நிறுத்த முடியவில்லை, குறிப்பாகக் காலையில்.

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: என் தொண்டை மிகவும் வலிக்கிறது, சாப்பாடு விழுங்கும்போதும், தண்ணீர் விழுங்கும்போது கூட வலிக்கிறது.

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: சுமார் இரண்டு வாரங்களாக எனக்கு இருமல் இருக்கிறது, சில நேரங்களில் மஞ்சள் சளி வருகிறது.

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: என் உடல் முழுவதும் வலிக்கிறது, மிகவும் சோர்வாக இருக்கிறது, குளிர் நடுக்கம் வந்துகொண்டே இருக்கிறது.
translator_notes: chills = குளிர் நடுக்கம்

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: உங்களுக்கு ஏதாவது தடிப்புகள், ஈறுகளில் இரத்தக் கசிவு, அல்லது கண்களுக்குப் பின்னால் வலி இருப்பதைக் கவனித்தீர்களா?
translator_notes: rash = தடிப்பு

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: கிட்டத்தட்ட ஒவ்வொரு நாளும் மதிய நேரத்தில் எனக்குத் தலைவலி வருகிறது, வலி நிவாரண மாத்திரைகள் சில மணி நேரம் மட்டுமே உதவுகின்றன.
translator_notes: painkillers = வலி நிவாரண மாத்திரைகள்

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: இன்று காலையிலிருந்து எனக்கு ஐந்து முறை வயிற்றுப்போக்கு ஆகியிருக்கிறது, வாந்தி வருவது போலவும் இருக்கிறது.

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: நிறையத் தண்ணீரும் ஓ.ஆர்.எஸ் கரைசலும் குடியுங்கள், சில நாட்களுக்கு எண்ணெய் அல்லது காரமான உணவுகளைத் தவிர்த்துவிடுங்கள்.
translator_notes: oral rehydration salts rendered as the commonly used loan acronym ORS (ஓ.ஆர்.எஸ்) + கரைசல் (solution)

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translation: என் மேல் வயிற்றில் எரிவது போன்ற வலி இருக்கிறது, பசியாக இருக்கும்போது அது அதிகமாகிறது.

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: என் கைகளில் அரிப்புடன் சிவப்புத் தடிப்பு இருக்கிறது, நான் சோப்பை மாற்றிய பிறகு அது ஆரம்பித்தது.
translator_notes: கைகள் covers arms; soap as loanword சோப்பு

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: வேலையில் ஒரு கனமான பெட்டியைத் தூக்கும்போது என் கீழ் முதுகில் காயம் ஏற்பட்டது, இப்போது என்னால் குனிய முடியவில்லை.

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: நான் வேகமாக எழுந்து நிற்கும்போது எனக்குத் தலை சுற்றுகிறது, சில நேரங்களில் எல்லாம் சுற்ற ஆரம்பிக்கிறது.

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: என் நெஞ்சில் இறுக்கமான உணர்வு இருக்கிறது, நான் நடக்கும்போது அது என் இடது கைக்குப் பரவுகிறது.

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: இது தீவிரமானதாக இருக்கலாம், அதனால் நான் உங்களை இப்போதே அவசர சிகிச்சைப் பிரிவுக்கு அனுப்பப் போகிறேன்.

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: இரவில் என் ஆஸ்துமா மோசமாகி வருகிறது, என் இன்ஹேலர் முன்பு போல் நன்றாக வேலை செய்வதாகத் தெரியவில்லை.
translator_notes: 'as well' rendered as முன்பு போல் (like before)

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: சிறுநீர் கழிக்கும்போது எரிச்சலாக இருக்கிறது, நான் மிகவும் அடிக்கடி கழிப்பறைக்குப் போக வேண்டியிருக்கிறது.

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: என் கண் மூன்று நாட்களாகச் சிவந்து நீர் வடிந்துகொண்டிருக்கிறது, நான் தூங்கி எழும்போது அது ஒட்டிக்கொண்டிருக்கிறது.

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: என் மகனுக்கு வலது காதில் வலி இருக்கிறது, அவன் இரவு முழுவதும் அழுதுகொண்டும் காதைப் பிடித்து இழுத்துக்கொண்டும் இருந்தான்.
translator_notes: 'it' rendered as காதை (the ear) for clarity.

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: என் கால் பெருவிரல் வீங்கி மிகவும் வலிக்கிறது, என்னால் காலணி கூட அணிய முடியவில்லை.
translator_notes: காலணி used for shoes (standard); spoken alternative ஷூ not used.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translation: உங்கள் இரத்தத்தில் சர்க்கரை அளவு இன்னும் அதிகமாகவே இருக்கிறது, அதனால் உங்கள் சர்க்கரை நோய் மருந்தை நாம் அதிகரிக்க வேண்டும்.
translator_notes: சர்க்கரை நோய் (everyday term for diabetes) chosen over நீரிழிவு; emphatic -ஏ conveys 'quite'.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: இன்று உங்கள் இரத்த அழுத்தம் 160க்கு 95 ஆக இருக்கிறது, இது இருக்க வேண்டியதைவிட அதிகம்.
translator_notes: '160 over 95' rendered as 160க்கு 95, the way Tamil speakers read BP aloud.

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: தயவுசெய்து உங்கள் இரத்தப் பரிசோதனைக்கு முன் 10 மணி நேரம் வெறும் தண்ணீரைத் தவிர வேறு எதையும் சாப்பிடவோ குடிக்கவோ வேண்டாம்.

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: நான் வாழ்நாள் முழுவதும் கொலஸ்ட்ரால் மருந்து எடுத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டுமா, அல்லது அது சாதாரண நிலைக்கு வந்தவுடன் நிறுத்திவிடலாமா?

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: உங்களுக்கு பெனிசிலின் அல்லது ஆஸ்பிரின் போன்ற ஏதாவது மருந்துகளால் ஒவ்வாமை இருக்கிறதா?
translator_notes: ஒவ்வாமை (standard) chosen over the loanword அலர்ஜி, which is also very common in speech.

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: ஒரு மாத்திரையை ஒரு நாளைக்கு மூன்று வேளை சாப்பாட்டுக்குப் பிறகு எடுத்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள், ஆன்டிபயாடிக் மருந்து முழுவதையும் முடித்துவிடுங்கள்.
translator_notes: ஆன்டிபயாடிக் loanword used (everyday); 'whole course' rendered as மருந்து முழுவதையும்.

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: இந்த மருந்து உங்களுக்குத் தூக்கக் கலக்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்தலாம், அதனால் இதை எடுத்துக்கொண்ட பிறகு வாகனம் ஓட்டவோ இயந்திரங்களை இயக்கவோ வேண்டாம்.

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translation: இந்த மருந்தை என் இரத்த அழுத்த மாத்திரைகளுடன் சேர்த்து எடுத்துக்கொள்ளலாமா?

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: எனக்கு இரண்டு நாட்களுக்கு மருத்துவச் சான்றிதழ் கொடுக்க முடியுமா? என் முதலாளிக்கு அது தேவைப்படுகிறது.
translator_notes: மருத்துவச் சான்றிதழ் used; Singapore speakers often just say MC.

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: நான் 20 வாரம் கர்ப்பமாக இருக்கிறேன். நான் ஃப்ளூ தடுப்பூசி போட்டுக்கொள்வது பாதுகாப்பானதா?
translator_notes: Tamil first-person verbs are not gender-marked; ஃப்ளூ loanword used for flu.

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: என் வழக்கமான மருந்து தீரப்போகிறது. நான் மருத்துவரைப் பார்க்காமலேயே மீண்டும் மருந்து வாங்க முடியுமா?
translator_notes: 'refill' rendered as மீண்டும் மருந்து வாங்க (get medicine again).

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: மூன்று நாட்களில் காய்ச்சல் குறையாவிட்டாலோ, உங்கள் உடல்நிலை மேலும் மோசமானாலோ, தயவுசெய்து உடனே திரும்பி வாருங்கள்.

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: உங்கள் முழங்காலுக்கு எக்ஸ்-ரே மற்றும் சிறப்பு மருத்துவர் பரிசோதனைக்காக உங்களை மருத்துவமனைக்குப் பரிந்துரைக்கிறேன்.

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: ஒரு மாதமாக என்னால் சரியாகத் தூங்க முடியவில்லை, எனக்கு எப்போதும் மன அழுத்தமாகவும் பதற்றமாகவும் இருக்கிறது.

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.
translation: சர்க்கரையையும் உப்பையும் குறைத்துக்கொள்ள முயற்சி செய்யுங்கள், பெரும்பாலான நாட்களில் குறைந்தது 30 நிமிடங்கள் உடற்பயிற்சி செய்யுங்கள்.

speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: ကျွန်တော် မနေ့ညကတည်းက ဖျားနေတယ်၊ ဒီနေ့မနက် ကိုယ်အပူချိန် 38.5 ဒီဂရီ ရှိတယ်။

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: ကျွန်တော် နှာရည် မပြတ်ယိုနေပြီး နှာချေတာလည်း မရပ်နိုင်ဘူး၊ အထူးသဖြင့် မနက်ပိုင်းမှာပါ။

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: ကျွန်တော့် လည်ချောင်း အရမ်းနာပြီး အစာ ဒါမှမဟုတ် ရေတောင် မျိုရင် နာတယ်။

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: ကျွန်တော် ချောင်းဆိုးနေတာ နှစ်ပတ်လောက် ရှိပြီ၊ တစ်ခါတလေ သလိပ်အဝါ ထွက်တယ်။

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: ကျွန်တော် တစ်ကိုယ်လုံး ကိုက်ခဲနေတယ်၊ အရမ်းပင်ပန်းနေတယ်၊ ပြီးတော့ ခဏခဏ ချမ်းတုန်နေတယ်။

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: အဖုအပိမ့်တွေ ထွက်တာ၊ သွားဖုံးက သွေးထွက်တာ ဒါမှမဟုတ် မျက်လုံးနောက်ဘက်မှာ နာတာမျိုး သတိထားမိပါသလား။
translator_notes: Pronoun 'you' omitted (natural, polite, gender-neutral).

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: ကျွန်တော် နေ့လယ်ခင်းတိုင်းလိုလို ခေါင်းကိုက်တယ်၊ အကိုက်အခဲပျောက်ဆေးက နာရီအနည်းငယ်ပဲ သက်သာစေတယ်။
translator_notes: Painkiller = အကိုက်အခဲပျောက်ဆေး.

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: ကျွန်တော် ဒီမနက်ကတည်းက ဝမ်းငါးခါ လျှောပြီးပြီ၊ အန်ချင်သလိုလည်း ဖြစ်နေတယ်။

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: ရေနဲ့ ဓာတ်ဆားရည် များများ သောက်ပါ၊ ပြီးတော့ ရက်အနည်းငယ်လောက် အဆီများတဲ့ ဒါမှမဟုတ် စပ်တဲ့ အစားအစာတွေကို ရှောင်ပါ။
translator_notes: ORS = ဓာတ်ဆားရည် (everyday term).

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translator_notes: Kept literal 'upper stomach' rather than colloquial ရင်ညွန့်.

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: ကျွန်တော့် လက်မောင်းတွေမှာ ယားတဲ့ အနီရောင် အဖုအပိမ့်တွေ ထွက်နေတယ်၊ ဆပ်ပြာ ပြောင်းသုံးပြီးမှ စဖြစ်တာ။

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: အလုပ်မှာ လေးတဲ့ သေတ္တာတစ်လုံး မရင်း ကျွန်တော့် ခါးအောက်ပိုင်း နာသွားတယ်၊ အခု ကုန်းလို့ မရတော့ဘူး။

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: ကျွန်တော် မြန်မြန် မတ်တပ်ထရပ်ရင် ခေါင်းမူးတယ်၊ တစ်ခါတလေ အရာအားလုံး ချာချာလည်လာတယ်။

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: ကျွန်တော် ရင်ဘတ်ထဲမှာ ကျပ်နေသလို ခံစားရတယ်၊ လမ်းလျှောက်တဲ့အခါ ဘယ်ဘက်လက်မောင်းဆီကို ပျံ့သွားတယ်။

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: ဒါက စိုးရိမ်ရတဲ့ အခြေအနေ ဖြစ်နိုင်တဲ့အတွက် အခုချက်ချင်း အရေးပေါ်ဌာနကို ပို့ပေးပါမယ်။
translator_notes: Pronouns omitted (natural in spoken Burmese).

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: ညဘက်မှာ ကျွန်တော့် ပန်းနာရင်ကျပ် ပိုဆိုးလာတယ်၊ ရှူဆေးကလည်း အရင်လောက် မစွမ်းတော့သလိုပဲ။
translator_notes: Inhaler = ရှူဆေး (everyday term).

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: ဆီးသွားရင် ပူလောင်တယ်၊ ပြီးတော့ အိမ်သာကို အရမ်း ခဏခဏ သွားရတယ်။

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: ကျွန်တော့်မျက်လုံးက နီပြီး မျက်ရည်ကျနေတာ သုံးရက်ရှိပြီ၊ အိပ်ရာနိုးတဲ့အခါ စေးကပ်နေတယ်။

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: ကျွန်တော့်သားက ညာဘက်နား နာနေတယ်၊ တစ်ညလုံး ငိုပြီး နားကို ဆွဲနေတယ်။

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: ကျွန်တော့်ခြေမကြီးက ရောင်ပြီး အရမ်းနာနေတယ်၊ ဖိနပ်တောင် မစီးနိုင်ဘူး။
translator_notes: ဖိနပ် is the everyday word for footwear/shoes.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translator_notes: Blood sugar = သွေးထဲက သကြားဓာတ်; diabetes = ဆီးချို. Possessive 'your' omitted (natural in Burmese, avoids gendered pronoun).

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: ဒီနေ့ သွေးပေါင်က 160 နဲ့ 95 ရှိတယ်၊ ဒါက ရှိသင့်တာထက် မြင့်နေတယ်။
translator_notes: '160 over 95' rendered as '160 နဲ့ 95', the usual spoken way to read BP in Burmese.

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: သွေးမစစ်ခင် 10 နာရီအတွင်း ရေရိုးရိုးကလွဲရင် ဘာမှ မစားပါနဲ့၊ မသောက်ပါနဲ့။

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: ကိုလက်စထရောဆေးကို တစ်သက်လုံး သောက်ရမှာလား၊ ဒါမှမဟုတ် ပုံမှန်ဖြစ်သွားရင် ရပ်လို့ရလား။
translator_notes: Cholesterol as loanword ကိုလက်စထရော.

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: ပင်နီစလင် ဒါမှမဟုတ် အက်စ်ပရင်လို ဆေးတစ်ခုခုနဲ့ ဓာတ်မတည့်တာ ရှိပါသလား။
translator_notes: Allergy = ဓာတ်မတည့်; drug names as Burmese-script loanwords.

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: တစ်နေ့ သုံးကြိမ် အစာစားပြီးတိုင်း တစ်လုံးစီ သောက်ပါ၊ ပဋိဇီဝဆေးကိုလည်း အကုန်ကုန်အောင် သောက်ပါ။
translator_notes: Antibiotics = ပဋိဇီဝဆေး (standard, widely understood).

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: ဒီဆေးက အိပ်ချင်စေနိုင်တယ်၊ ဒါကြောင့် သောက်ပြီးရင် ကားမမောင်းပါနဲ့၊ စက်ယန္တရားတွေလည်း မကိုင်ပါနဲ့။

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translator_notes: Blood pressure pills = သွေးတိုးဆေး (everyday term).

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: ကျွန်တော့်ကို နှစ်ရက်စာ ဆေးလက်မှတ် ပေးလို့ရမလား။ ကျွန်တော့်အလုပ်ရှင်က လိုတယ်။
translator_notes: Medical certificate = ဆေးလက်မှတ်.

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: ကျွန်မ ကိုယ်ဝန် 20 ပတ် ရှိပြီ။ တုပ်ကွေးကာကွယ်ဆေး ထိုးလို့ စိတ်ချရလား။
translator_notes: Feminine pronoun ကျွန်မ per guide (pregnant speaker). 'Safe' = စိတ်ချရ (natural spoken).

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: ကျွန်တော် ပုံမှန်သောက်နေတဲ့ဆေး ကုန်တော့မယ်။ ဆရာဝန်နဲ့ မတွေ့ဘဲ ဆေးထပ်ယူလို့ ရမလား။

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: သုံးရက်အတွင်း အဖျားမကျရင် ဒါမှမဟုတ် ပိုဆိုးလာတယ်လို့ ခံစားရရင် ချက်ချင်း ပြန်လာပါ။

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: ဒူးကို ဓာတ်မှန်ရိုက်ဖို့နဲ့ အထူးကုဆရာဝန်နဲ့ စစ်ဆေးဖို့ ဆေးရုံကို လွှဲပေးပါမယ်။
translator_notes: X-ray = ဓာတ်မှန် (everyday Burmese word).

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: ကျွန်တော် တစ်လရှိပြီ ကောင်းကောင်း အိပ်မပျော်ဘူး၊ အချိန်တိုင်း စိတ်ဖိစီးပြီး စိတ်ပူပန်နေတယ်။

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.

speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: ผมเป็นไข้ตั้งแต่เมื่อคืน แล้วเช้านี้วัดไข้ได้ 38.5 องศา
translator_notes: วัดไข้ได้ = measured temperature; natural spoken phrasing for 'my temperature was'.

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: ผมน้ำมูกไหลตลอด แล้วก็จามไม่หยุด โดยเฉพาะตอนเช้า

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: ผมเจ็บคอมาก เวลากลืนอาหารหรือแม้แต่น้ำก็เจ็บ

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: ผมไอมาประมาณสองอาทิตย์แล้ว บางครั้งมีเสมหะสีเหลือง
translator_notes: อาทิตย์ (spoken) used for week rather than สัปดาห์.

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: ผมปวดเมื่อยไปทั้งตัว รู้สึกเหนื่อยมาก แล้วก็หนาวสั่นอยู่เรื่อยๆ

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: คุณสังเกตเห็นว่ามีผื่น เลือดออกตามไรฟัน หรือปวดหลังกระบอกตาบ้างไหม
translator_notes: ปวดหลังกระบอกตา = standard lay term for retro-orbital pain in dengue.

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: ผมปวดหัวเกือบทุกบ่าย แล้วยาแก้ปวดก็ช่วยได้แค่ไม่กี่ชั่วโมง

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: ตั้งแต่เช้าผมท้องเสียถ่ายไปห้าครั้งแล้ว และรู้สึกอยากอาเจียนด้วย

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: ดื่มน้ำและเกลือแร่เยอะๆ และงดอาหารมันๆ หรือเผ็ดๆ สักสองสามวัน
translator_notes: เกลือแร่ = everyday Thai term for ORS; สักสองสามวัน is the idiomatic Thai for 'a few days'.

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translation: ผมปวดแสบท้องส่วนบน แล้วจะปวดมากขึ้นเวลาหิว

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: ผมมีผื่นแดงคันขึ้นที่แขน และเริ่มเป็นหลังจากเปลี่ยนสบู่

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: ผมเจ็บหลังส่วนล่างตอนยกกล่องหนักๆ ที่ทำงาน แล้วตอนนี้ก้มตัวไม่ได้

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: ผมเวียนหัวเวลาลุกขึ้นยืนเร็วๆ และบางครั้งทุกอย่างก็เริ่มหมุน

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: ผมรู้สึกแน่นหน้าอก และเวลาเดินจะร้าวไปที่แขนซ้าย
translator_notes: ร้าว = radiating pain, the everyday word for 'spreads'.

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: อาการนี้อาจจะร้ายแรง เพราะฉะนั้นหมอจะส่งคุณไปห้องฉุกเฉินตอนนี้เลย
translator_notes: Doctor self-refers as หมอ (gender-neutral, natural in Thai clinics); ห้องฉุกเฉิน is the everyday term for the emergency department.

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: อาการหอบหืดของผมแย่ลงตอนกลางคืน แล้วยาพ่นก็ดูเหมือนจะได้ผลไม่ดีเท่าเดิม
translator_notes: ยาพ่น = inhaler in everyday Thai.

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: เวลาปัสสาวะจะรู้สึกแสบ และต้องเข้าห้องน้ำบ่อยมาก

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: ตาผมแดงและน้ำตาไหลมาสามวันแล้ว และตอนตื่นนอนตาจะเหนียว
translator_notes: Thai does not mark singular 'eye' without adding 'one side'; left unmarked.

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: ลูกชายผมปวดหูข้างขวา เขาร้องไห้แล้วก็ดึงหูทั้งคืน

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: นิ้วโป้งเท้าผมบวมและปวดมาก ใส่รองเท้ายังไม่ได้เลย
translator_notes: นิ้วโป้งเท้า is the everyday term for big toe.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translation: น้ำตาลในเลือดของคุณยังค่อนข้างสูงอยู่ เราเลยต้องเพิ่มยาเบาหวานของคุณ

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: ความดันโลหิตของคุณวันนี้อยู่ที่ 160 ต่อ 95 ซึ่งสูงกว่าที่ควรจะเป็น
translator_notes: 'over' rendered as ต่อ as spoken aloud.

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: กรุณาอย่ากินหรือดื่มอะไรนอกจากน้ำเปล่า เป็นเวลา 10 ชั่วโมงก่อนตรวจเลือด

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: ผมต้องกินยาลดคอเลสเตอรอลไปตลอดชีวิตไหม หรือหยุดได้เมื่อค่าปกติแล้ว
translator_notes: ยาลดไขมัน is also common colloquially; kept คอเลสเตอรอล to stay faithful.

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: คุณแพ้ยาอะไรไหม เช่น เพนิซิลลินหรือแอสไพริน

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: กินยาครั้งละหนึ่งเม็ด วันละสามครั้งหลังอาหาร และกินยาปฏิชีวนะให้หมดทั้งคอร์ส
translator_notes: ยาปฏิชีวนะ used (laypeople also say ยาฆ่าเชื้อ).

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: ยานี้อาจทำให้คุณง่วงนอน เพราะฉะนั้นหลังกินยาอย่าขับรถหรือทำงานกับเครื่องจักร

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translation: ผมกินยานี้พร้อมกับยาความดันของผมได้ไหม
translator_notes: ยาความดัน is the everyday term for blood pressure pills.

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: คุณหมอออกใบรับรองแพทย์สองวันให้ผมได้ไหม นายจ้างของผมต้องใช้
translator_notes: Patient addresses doctor as คุณหมอ.

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: ดิฉันตั้งครรภ์ได้ 20 สัปดาห์แล้ว ฉีดวัคซีนไข้หวัดใหญ่จะปลอดภัยสำหรับดิฉันไหม
translator_notes: Female speaker: ดิฉัน. ตั้งครรภ์ chosen over ท้อง to avoid ambiguity.

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: ยาประจำของผมใกล้จะหมดแล้ว ผมขอรับยาเพิ่มโดยไม่ต้องพบหมอได้ไหม

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: ถ้าไข้ไม่ลดภายในสามวัน หรือคุณรู้สึกแย่ลง กรุณากลับมาทันที

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: หมอจะส่งตัวคุณไปโรงพยาบาลเพื่อเอกซเรย์และให้แพทย์เฉพาะทางตรวจเข่าของคุณ
translator_notes: Doctor self-reference หมอ (gender-neutral). เอกซเรย์ is the standard spelling.

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: ผมนอนไม่ค่อยหลับมาหนึ่งเดือนแล้ว และรู้สึกเครียดและกังวลตลอดเวลา

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.
translation: พยายามลดน้ำตาลและเกลือ และออกกำลังกายอย่างน้อย 30 นาทีเกือบทุกวัน

speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: Saya demam sejak tadi malam, dan tadi pagi suhu badan saya 38.5 derajat.
translator_notes: Kept 38.5 with a point as in the source (per guide), not Indonesian decimal comma.

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: Hidung saya terus meler dan saya tidak bisa berhenti bersin, terutama di pagi hari.

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: Tenggorokan saya sakit sekali dan terasa sakit saat saya menelan makanan atau bahkan air.

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: Saya sudah batuk sekitar dua minggu, dan kadang-kadang ada dahak kuning.

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: Seluruh badan saya pegal-pegal, saya merasa sangat lelah, dan saya terus menggigil.
translator_notes: "pegal-pegal" is the everyday word for flu-type body aches; "menggigil" = chills/shivering.

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: Apakah Anda melihat ada ruam, gusi berdarah, atau nyeri di belakang mata Anda?

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: Saya sakit kepala hampir setiap sore, dan obat pereda nyeri hanya membantu selama beberapa jam.
translator_notes: "sore" = afternoon; "obat pereda nyeri" for painkillers.

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: Saya sudah diare lima kali sejak tadi pagi, dan saya juga merasa ingin muntah.

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: Minum banyak air dan oralit, dan hindari makanan berminyak atau pedas selama beberapa hari.
translator_notes: "oralit" is the everyday Indonesian word for oral rehydration salts.

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translation: Saya merasakan nyeri seperti terbakar di perut bagian atas, dan rasanya makin parah kalau saya lapar.

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: Ada ruam merah yang gatal di lengan saya, dan itu mulai setelah saya ganti sabun.
translator_notes: "lengan saya" is number-neutral; did not add "kedua" (both).

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: Punggung bawah saya cedera saat saya mengangkat kotak yang berat di tempat kerja, dan sekarang saya tidak bisa membungkuk.

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: Saya merasa pusing saat saya berdiri dengan cepat, dan kadang-kadang semuanya mulai berputar.

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: Saya merasa sesak di dada, dan rasanya menjalar ke lengan kiri saya saat saya berjalan.
translator_notes: "sesak di dada" is the common lay phrase for chest tightness (can also suggest breathlessness).

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: Ini bisa serius, jadi saya akan mengirim Anda ke unit gawat darurat sekarang juga.
translator_notes: Spelled out "unit gawat darurat" rather than the acronym IGD/UGD.

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: Asma saya makin parah pada malam hari, dan inhaler saya sepertinya tidak seampuh biasanya.
translator_notes: "inhaler" is the common loanword.

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: Rasanya perih saat saya buang air kecil, dan saya harus sering sekali ke toilet.
translator_notes: "perih" for burning sensation on urination.

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: Mata saya sudah tiga hari merah dan berair, dan terasa lengket waktu saya bangun tidur.

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: Telinga kanan anak laki-laki saya sakit, dan semalaman dia menangis dan menarik-narik telinganya.
translator_notes: 'anak laki-laki' used to keep 'son' explicit.

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: Jempol kaki saya bengkak dan sakit sekali, sampai saya bahkan tidak bisa memakai sepatu.
translator_notes: 'jempol kaki' is the everyday term for big toe.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translation: Gula darah Anda masih cukup tinggi, jadi kita perlu menambah obat diabetes Anda.
translator_notes: 'menambah obat' kept as ambiguous as the English (dose vs. medication).

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: Tekanan darah Anda hari ini 160 per 95, dan itu lebih tinggi dari yang seharusnya.
translator_notes: 'per' is how 'over' is said aloud for BP readings.

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: Tolong jangan makan atau minum apa pun kecuali air putih selama 10 jam sebelum tes darah Anda.
translator_notes: 'air putih' = plain water.

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: Apakah saya harus minum obat kolesterol seumur hidup, atau saya bisa berhenti kalau sudah normal?

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: Apakah Anda alergi terhadap obat apa pun, seperti penisilin atau aspirin?
translator_notes: Indonesian spelling 'penisilin'.

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: Minum satu tablet tiga kali sehari sesudah makan, dan habiskan semua antibiotiknya.
translator_notes: 'habiskan semua antibiotiknya' is the usual way to say finish the course.

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: Obat ini bisa membuat Anda mengantuk, jadi jangan menyetir atau mengoperasikan mesin setelah meminumnya.

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translation: Apakah saya boleh minum obat ini bersamaan dengan obat tekanan darah saya?
translator_notes: 'obat tekanan darah' used for 'blood pressure pills'.

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: Bisakah Dokter memberi saya surat keterangan sakit untuk dua hari? Majikan saya memerlukannya.
translator_notes: 'surat keterangan sakit' = MC; 'majikan' = employer (alternative: 'perusahaan saya').

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: Saya sedang hamil 20 minggu. Apakah aman bagi saya untuk mendapat vaksin flu?
translator_notes: Indonesian has no gendered forms.

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: Obat rutin saya hampir habis. Apakah saya bisa mengambil obat lagi tanpa bertemu dokter?
translator_notes: 'mengambil obat lagi' used for 'refill'.

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: Kalau demamnya tidak turun dalam tiga hari atau Anda merasa lebih buruk, tolong segera datang kembali.

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: Saya akan merujuk Anda ke rumah sakit untuk rontgen dan pemeriksaan lutut Anda oleh dokter spesialis.
translator_notes: 'rontgen' is the everyday Indonesian word for X-ray.

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: Sudah sebulan saya tidak bisa tidur nyenyak, dan saya merasa stres dan cemas terus-menerus.

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.
translation: Coba kurangi gula dan garam, dan berolahraga setidaknya 30 menit hampir setiap hari.

speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: मुझे कल रात से बुखार है, और आज सुबह मेरा टेम्परेचर 38.5 डिग्री था।
translator_notes: टेम्परेचर (loanword) is what people commonly say instead of तापमान.

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: मेरी नाक बहती रहती है और मेरी छींकें रुकती नहीं हैं, खासकर सुबह के समय।

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: मेरे गले में बहुत दर्द है, और खाना या पानी तक निगलने में दर्द होता है।
translator_notes: तक = 'even'.

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: मुझे लगभग दो हफ़्ते से खांसी हो रही है, और कभी-कभी पीला बलगम आता है।

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: मेरे पूरे शरीर में दर्द हो रहा है, मुझे बहुत थकान लग रही है, और बार-बार ठंड लग रही है।
translator_notes: ठंड लगना is the everyday expression for chills.

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: क्या आपने ध्यान दिया है कि कोई दाने निकले हैं, मसूड़ों से खून आया है, या आँखों के पीछे दर्द होता है?
translator_notes: दाने used for rash (everyday word).

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: मुझे लगभग हर दोपहर सिरदर्द होता है, और पेनकिलर से बस कुछ ही घंटों तक आराम रहता है।
translator_notes: पेनकिलर loanword commonly used; दर्द की दवा also possible.

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: मुझे आज सुबह से पाँच बार दस्त हो चुके हैं, और मुझे उल्टी जैसा भी लग रहा है।

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: खूब पानी और ओआरएस का घोल पिएँ, और कुछ दिनों तक तेल वाला या मसालेदार खाना न खाएँ।
translator_notes: Oral rehydration salts rendered as ओआरएस (ORS), the term Hindi speakers actually use.

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translation: मेरे पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से में जलन वाला दर्द है, और भूख लगने पर यह बढ़ जाता है।

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: मेरी बाँहों पर खुजली वाले लाल दाने हैं, और ये मेरे साबुन बदलने के बाद शुरू हुए।

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: काम पर एक भारी डिब्बा उठाते समय मेरी कमर के निचले हिस्से में चोट लग गई, और अब मैं झुक नहीं पा रहा हूँ।
translator_notes: Masculine पा रहा for patient.

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: जब मैं जल्दी से खड़ा होता हूँ तो मुझे चक्कर आता है, और कभी-कभी सब कुछ घूमने लगता है।
translator_notes: Masculine खड़ा होता for patient.

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: मेरे सीने में जकड़न महसूस होती है, और जब मैं चलता हूँ तो यह मेरी बाईं बाँह तक फैल जाती है।
translator_notes: Masculine चलता for patient.

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: यह गंभीर हो सकता है, इसलिए मैं आपको अभी इमरजेंसी विभाग भेज रहा हूँ।
translator_notes: इमरजेंसी loanword; masculine भेज रहा for doctor.

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: मेरा अस्थमा रात में बढ़ता जा रहा है, और लगता है मेरा इनहेलर पहले जितना असर नहीं कर रहा है।
translator_notes: अस्थमा and इनहेलर loanwords.

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: पेशाब करते समय जलन होती है, और मुझे बहुत बार टॉयलेट जाना पड़ता है।

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: मेरी आँख तीन दिन से लाल है और उससे पानी आ रहा है, और जब मैं सोकर उठता हूँ तो वह चिपचिपी होती है।
translator_notes: watery rendered as 'पानी आ रहा है' (water coming), the everyday expression.

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: मेरे बेटे के दाएँ कान में दर्द है, और वह पूरी रात रोता रहा है और अपना कान खींचता रहा है।
translator_notes: 'pulling at it' made explicit as 'अपना कान' for natural Hindi.

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: मेरे पैर का अँगूठा सूजा हुआ है और उसमें बहुत दर्द है, और मैं जूते भी नहीं पहन पा रहा हूँ।
translator_notes: 'big toe' = पैर का अँगूठा (everyday term).

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translation: आपका ब्लड शुगर अभी भी काफ़ी ज़्यादा है, इसलिए हमें आपकी डायबिटीज़ की दवा बढ़ानी होगी।
translator_notes: ब्लड शुगर and डायबिटीज़ are the common loanwords.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: आज आपका ब्लड प्रेशर 160 बटा 95 है, जो जितना होना चाहिए उससे ज़्यादा है।
translator_notes: 'over' in BP reading rendered as बटा, the usual spoken form.

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: कृपया अपने ब्लड टेस्ट से 10 घंटे पहले तक सादे पानी के अलावा कुछ भी न खाएँ और न पिएँ।

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: क्या मुझे कोलेस्ट्रॉल की दवा पूरी ज़िंदगी लेनी पड़ेगी, या कोलेस्ट्रॉल नॉर्मल हो जाने पर मैं इसे बंद कर सकता हूँ?
translator_notes: 'it' in 'once it's normal' made explicit as cholesterol to avoid ambiguity.

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: क्या आपको किसी दवा से एलर्जी है, जैसे पेनिसिलिन या एस्पिरिन?

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: एक गोली दिन में तीन बार खाने के बाद लें, और एंटीबायोटिक का पूरा कोर्स ख़त्म करें।

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: इस दवा से आपको नींद आ सकती है, इसलिए इसे लेने के बाद गाड़ी न चलाएँ और न ही कोई मशीन चलाएँ।

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translation: क्या मैं यह दवा अपनी ब्लड प्रेशर की गोलियों के साथ ले सकता हूँ?

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: क्या आप मुझे दो दिन का मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट दे सकते हैं? मेरे एम्प्लॉयर को यह चाहिए।
translator_notes: 'employer' kept as loanword एम्प्लॉयर; नियोक्ता is too formal, मालिक implies owner.

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: मैं 20 हफ़्ते की प्रेग्नेंट हूँ। क्या मेरे लिए फ़्लू का टीका लगवाना सुरक्षित है?
translator_notes: Feminine speaker (हफ़्ते की). टीका chosen over वैक्सीन.

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: मेरी रोज़ की दवा ख़त्म होने वाली है। क्या मुझे डॉक्टर से मिले बिना दवा दोबारा मिल सकती है?
translator_notes: 'refill' rendered as दवा दोबारा मिलना; 'regular' as रोज़ की.

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: अगर तीन दिन में बुखार न उतरे या आपकी तबीयत और बिगड़ जाए, तो कृपया तुरंत वापस आएँ।

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: मैं आपके घुटने के एक्स-रे और स्पेशलिस्ट से जाँच के लिए आपको अस्पताल रेफ़र करूँगा।

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: मैं एक महीने से ठीक से सो नहीं पा रहा हूँ, और मुझे हर समय तनाव और घबराहट महसूस होती है।
translator_notes: anxious = घबराहट (everyday); तनाव kept over टेंशन.

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.
translation: चीनी और नमक कम करने की कोशिश करें, और ज़्यादातर दिनों में कम से कम 30 मिनट एक्सरसाइज़ करें।
translator_notes: एक्सरसाइज़ is the common everyday word.

speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: May lagnat na po ako mula pa kagabi, at kaninang umaga, 38.5 degrees ang temperatura ko.

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: Tuloy-tuloy po ang tulo ng sipon ko at hindi ko mapigilang bumahing, lalo na sa umaga.

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: Masakit na masakit po ang lalamunan ko at sumasakit ito kapag lumulunok ako ng pagkain o kahit tubig.

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: Mga dalawang linggo na po akong inuubo, at kung minsan ay may dilaw na plema.

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: Masakit po ang buong katawan ko, pagod na pagod ako, at palagi akong ginaginaw.

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: May napansin ba kayong mga pantal, pagdurugo ng gilagid, o pananakit sa likod ng mga mata ninyo?
translator_notes: Doctor uses polite kayo/ninyo without po.

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: Sumasakit po ang ulo ko halos tuwing hapon, at ilang oras lang tumatalab ang mga painkiller.
translator_notes: 'painkiller' kept as common loanword.

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: Limang beses na po akong nagtatae mula kaninang umaga, at parang nasusuka rin ako.

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: Uminom kayo ng maraming tubig at oral rehydration salts, at iwasan ninyo ang mamantika o maanghang na pagkain sa loob ng ilang araw.
translator_notes: 'oral rehydration salts' kept in English; in the Philippines 'ORS' or 'Oresol' is also common.

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translation: May mahapding pananakit po sa itaas na bahagi ng tiyan ko, at lumalala ito kapag gutom ako.

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: May makating pulang pantal po sa mga braso ko, at nagsimula ito pagkatapos kong magpalit ng sabon.

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: Nasaktan po ang ibabang bahagi ng likod ko habang nagbubuhat ako ng mabigat na kahon sa trabaho, at ngayon hindi na ako makayuko.

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: Nahihilo po ako kapag mabilis akong tumatayo, at kung minsan ay nagsisimulang umikot ang lahat.

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: May paninikip po sa dibdib ko, at kumakalat ito sa kaliwang braso ko kapag naglalakad ako.

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: Maaaring seryoso ito, kaya ipapadala ko kayo sa emergency department ngayon din.
translator_notes: 'emergency department' kept as loanword (Filipinos often say 'emergency').

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: Lumalala po ang hika ko sa gabi, at parang hindi na gaanong tumatalab ang inhaler ko.

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: Mahapdi po kapag umiihi ako, at kailangan kong pumunta sa banyo nang napakadalas.

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: Tatlong araw na pong namumula at nagluluha ang mata ko, at malagkit ito paggising ko.

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: Masakit po ang kanang tainga ng anak kong lalaki, at buong gabi siyang umiiyak at hinihila ito.
translator_notes: 'anak kong lalaki' keeps 'son' explicit.

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: Namamaga po at sobrang sakit ng hinlalaki ko sa paa, at hindi ko man lang maisuot ang sapatos ko.
translator_notes: 'hinlalaki sa paa' = big toe.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translation: Medyo mataas pa rin ang blood sugar ninyo, kaya kailangan nating dagdagan ang gamot ninyo sa diabetes.
translator_notes: 'blood sugar' kept as common clinic loanword.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: Ang blood pressure ninyo ngayong araw ay 160 over 95, na mas mataas kaysa sa dapat.
translator_notes: '160 over 95' as commonly said in clinics.

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: Pakiusap, huwag kayong kumain o uminom ng kahit ano maliban sa plain na tubig sa loob ng 10 oras bago ang blood test ninyo.

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: Kailangan ko po bang uminom ng gamot sa cholesterol habambuhay, o puwede ko na po itong itigil kapag normal na?

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: May allergy ba kayo sa anumang gamot, gaya ng penicillin o aspirin?

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: Uminom kayo ng isang tableta nang tatlong beses sa isang araw pagkatapos kumain, at tapusin ninyo ang buong kurso ng antibiotic.

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: Maaaring antukin kayo sa gamot na ito, kaya huwag kayong magmaneho o magpaandar ng makina pagkatapos ninyo itong inumin.

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translation: Puwede ko po bang inumin ang gamot na ito kasabay ng mga gamot ko sa blood pressure?
translator_notes: 'pills' rendered as 'mga gamot' (medicines), the usual spoken term.

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: Puwede po ba ninyo akong bigyan ng medical certificate para sa dalawang araw? Kailangan po ito ng employer ko.
translator_notes: 'medical certificate' and 'employer' kept as common loanwords.

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: 20 linggo na po akong buntis. Ligtas po ba para sa akin na magpa-flu vaccine?
translator_notes: Filipino has no grammatical gender; no change needed for female speaker.

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: Nauubusan na po ako ng regular kong gamot. Puwede po ba akong makakuha ng refill nang hindi nagpapatingin sa doktor?

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: Kung hindi bumaba ang lagnat sa loob ng tatlong araw o lumala ang pakiramdam ninyo, pakiusap, bumalik kayo kaagad.

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: Ire-refer ko kayo sa ospital para sa X-ray at para matingnan ng espesyalista ang tuhod ninyo.
translator_notes: 'ire-refer' is the usual clinic term.

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: Isang buwan na po akong hindi makatulog nang maayos, at palagi po akong stressed at balisa.

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.
translation: Subukan ninyong bawasan ang asukal at asin, at mag-ehersisyo nang hindi bababa sa 30 minuto halos araw-araw.
translator_notes: 'most days' rendered as 'halos araw-araw' (almost every day).

speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: Tôi bị sốt từ tối qua, và sáng nay nhiệt độ của tôi là 38.5 độ.
translator_notes: Kept 38.5 with a decimal point, as in the source (Vietnamese normally writes a decimal comma).

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: Tôi cứ bị sổ mũi và hắt hơi không ngừng, nhất là vào buổi sáng.
translator_notes: sổ mũi = runny nose.

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: Họng tôi rất đau và nuốt thức ăn hay thậm chí nuốt nước cũng thấy đau.

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: Tôi bị ho khoảng hai tuần nay, và đôi khi có đờm màu vàng.

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: Tôi bị đau nhức khắp người, cảm thấy rất mệt, và cứ bị ớn lạnh.
translator_notes: ớn lạnh = chills.

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: Anh có thấy bị phát ban, chảy máu chân răng, hoặc đau phía sau mắt không?
translator_notes: chảy máu chân răng is the everyday term for bleeding gums.

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: Hầu như chiều nào tôi cũng bị đau đầu, và thuốc giảm đau chỉ đỡ được vài tiếng.

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: Từ sáng tới giờ tôi bị tiêu chảy năm lần, và tôi cũng thấy buồn nôn.
translator_notes: buồn nôn = feel like vomiting / nausea.

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: Anh hãy uống nhiều nước và oresol, và tránh ăn đồ dầu mỡ hoặc đồ cay trong vài ngày.
translator_notes: oresol is the everyday Vietnamese word for oral rehydration salts.

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translation: Tôi bị đau nóng rát ở phần bụng trên, và khi đói thì đau hơn.
translator_notes: bụng trên chosen over the medical term thượng vị.

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: Tôi bị nổi mẩn đỏ ngứa trên hai cánh tay, và bắt đầu bị sau khi tôi đổi xà phòng.

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: Tôi bị đau lưng dưới lúc bê một thùng nặng ở chỗ làm, và bây giờ tôi không cúi xuống được.
translator_notes: bê = lift/carry (everyday).

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: Tôi bị chóng mặt khi đứng dậy nhanh, và đôi khi mọi thứ bắt đầu quay cuồng.

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: Tôi thấy tức ngực, và khi tôi đi bộ thì nó lan ra cánh tay trái.
translator_notes: tức ngực = tight feeling in the chest.

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: Tình trạng này có thể nghiêm trọng, nên tôi sẽ chuyển anh đến khoa cấp cứu ngay bây giờ.

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: Bệnh hen suyễn của tôi ngày càng nặng hơn vào ban đêm, và ống xịt của tôi có vẻ không còn tác dụng tốt như trước.
translator_notes: ống xịt = inhaler (everyday term).

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: Tôi thấy nóng rát khi đi tiểu, và tôi phải đi vệ sinh rất thường xuyên.

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: Mắt tôi bị đỏ và chảy nước mắt đã ba ngày nay, và khi ngủ dậy thì mắt bị dính.

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: Con trai tôi bị đau tai bên phải, và cả đêm cháu cứ khóc và kéo tai.

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: Ngón chân cái của tôi bị sưng và rất đau, tôi thậm chí không mang giày được.
translator_notes: "mang giày" (common in Southern usage); Northern equivalent is "đi giày".

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translation: Đường huyết của anh vẫn còn khá cao, nên chúng ta cần tăng liều thuốc tiểu đường của anh.
translator_notes: "tăng liều" (increase the dose) is how 'increase your medicine' is naturally said.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: Huyết áp của anh hôm nay là 160 trên 95, cao hơn mức nên có.
translator_notes: reviewer: changed "mức bình thường" to "mức nên có" to match "than it should be"

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: Anh vui lòng không ăn hay uống gì ngoài nước lọc trong 10 tiếng trước khi xét nghiệm máu.

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: Tôi có phải uống thuốc mỡ máu suốt đời không, hay khi nó bình thường lại thì tôi có thể ngừng uống?
translator_notes: "thuốc mỡ máu" is the everyday term for cholesterol medicine.

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: Anh có bị dị ứng với thuốc nào không, ví dụ như penicillin hay aspirin?
translator_notes: Drug names kept in common Latin spelling; Vietnamese pharmacopoeia also spells "penicilin".

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: Anh uống một viên, ngày ba lần sau bữa ăn, và uống hết cả đợt thuốc kháng sinh.

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: Thuốc này có thể làm anh buồn ngủ, nên sau khi uống thì đừng lái xe hay vận hành máy móc.

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translation: Tôi có thể uống thuốc này cùng với thuốc huyết áp của tôi không?

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: Bác sĩ có thể cho tôi giấy nghỉ bệnh hai ngày được không? Công ty tôi cần giấy đó.
translator_notes: "giấy nghỉ bệnh" = MC/sick-leave certificate (Northern: "giấy nghỉ ốm"); "công ty tôi" for 'my employer'.

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: Tôi đang mang thai 20 tuần. Tôi tiêm vắc-xin cúm có an toàn không?
translator_notes: Female speaker; Vietnamese has no forced gender marking here.

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: Thuốc tôi thường uống sắp hết rồi. Tôi có thể lấy thêm thuốc mà không cần gặp bác sĩ không?

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: Nếu trong ba ngày mà sốt không hạ hoặc anh thấy tệ hơn, thì anh hãy quay lại ngay.

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: Tôi sẽ chuyển anh đến bệnh viện để chụp X-quang và để bác sĩ chuyên khoa khám đầu gối cho anh.

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: Đã một tháng nay tôi không ngủ ngon được, và lúc nào tôi cũng thấy căng thẳng và lo lắng.

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.
translation: Anh cố gắng ăn bớt đường và muối, và tập thể dục ít nhất 30 phút vào hầu hết các ngày.

speaker: patient
english: I've had a fever since last night, and this morning my temperature was 38.5 degrees.
translation: 我从昨晚开始发烧，今天早上体温是38.5度。

speaker: patient
english: My nose keeps running and I can't stop sneezing, especially in the morning.
translation: 我一直流鼻涕，打喷嚏停不下来，特别是早上。

speaker: patient
english: My throat is very sore and it hurts when I swallow food or even water.
translation: 我的喉咙很痛，吞食物甚至喝水的时候都会痛。
translator_notes: 'swallow water' rendered as 喝水 (drink water), the natural spoken phrasing.

speaker: patient
english: I've been coughing for about two weeks, and sometimes there is yellow phlegm.
translation: 我咳嗽大概两个星期了，有时候有黄色的痰。

speaker: patient
english: My whole body is aching, I feel very tired, and I keep getting chills.
translation: 我全身酸痛，觉得很累，而且一直发冷。

speaker: doctor
english: Have you noticed any rashes, bleeding gums, or pain behind your eyes?
translation: 您有没有发现出疹子、牙龈出血，或者眼睛后面痛？
translator_notes: Polite 您 used for doctor to patient.

speaker: patient
english: I get headaches almost every afternoon, and painkillers only help for a few hours.
translation: 我几乎每天下午都会头痛，止痛药只能缓解几个小时。

speaker: patient
english: I've had diarrhoea five times since this morning, and I also feel like vomiting.
translation: 我从今天早上开始已经拉了五次肚子，而且也想吐。
translator_notes: 拉肚子 is the everyday word for diarrhoea.

speaker: doctor
english: Drink plenty of water and oral rehydration salts, and avoid oily or spicy food for a few days.
translation: 多喝水和口服补液盐，接下来几天不要吃油腻或辛辣的食物。

speaker: patient
english: I have a burning pain in my upper stomach, and it gets worse when I'm hungry.
translation: 我上腹有烧灼一样的痛，肚子饿的时候会更痛。
translator_notes: upper stomach rendered as 上腹 (upper abdomen).

speaker: patient
english: There's an itchy red rash on my arms, and it started after I changed my soap.
translation: 我的手臂上有很痒的红疹，是换了肥皂以后才开始的。

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back while lifting a heavy box at work, and now I can't bend down.
translation: 我在工作的时候搬一个很重的箱子，伤到了腰，现在不能弯腰。
translator_notes: lower back rendered as 腰, the everyday term (下背 is uncommon in speech).

speaker: patient
english: I feel dizzy when I stand up quickly, and sometimes everything starts spinning.
translation: 我快速站起来的时候会头晕，有时候会天旋地转。
translator_notes: 天旋地转 is the common idiom for everything spinning.

speaker: patient
english: I have a tight feeling in my chest, and it spreads to my left arm when I walk.
translation: 我胸口有紧绷的感觉，走路的时候会扩散到左手臂。

speaker: doctor
english: This could be serious, so I'm going to send you to the emergency department right now.
translation: 这可能很严重，所以我现在就要把您送去急诊部。
translator_notes: 急诊部 used for emergency department (A&E).

speaker: patient
english: My asthma is getting worse at night, and my inhaler doesn't seem to work as well.
translation: 我的哮喘晚上越来越严重，我的吸入器好像也没以前那么有效了。

speaker: patient
english: It burns when I pass urine, and I need to go to the toilet very often.
translation: 我小便的时候有灼热感，而且上厕所很频繁。

speaker: patient
english: My eye has been red and watery for three days, and it's sticky when I wake up.
translation: 我的眼睛又红又流眼泪，已经三天了，早上醒来的时候黏黏的。

speaker: patient
english: My son has pain in his right ear, and he's been crying and pulling at it all night.
translation: 我儿子右耳朵痛，他整个晚上一直在哭，还一直拉他的耳朵。

speaker: patient
english: My big toe is swollen and very painful, and I can't even wear my shoes.
translation: 我的大脚趾肿起来了，非常痛，连鞋子都穿不了。

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood sugar is still quite high, so we need to increase your diabetes medicine.
translation: 您的血糖还是相当高，所以我们需要增加您的糖尿病药。
translator_notes: 增加...药 is the everyday way of saying raise the dose; 剂量 not added.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is 160 over 95, which is higher than it should be.
translation: 您今天的血压是高压160，低压95，这比应该有的水平高。
translator_notes: '160 over 95' rendered as 高压160，低压95, the usual spoken form; avoids a slash.

speaker: doctor
english: Please don't eat or drink anything except plain water for 10 hours before your blood test.
translation: 请在验血前10个小时，除了白开水以外，不要吃喝任何东西。
translator_notes: 验血 is the common spoken term for blood test.

speaker: patient
english: Do I have to take cholesterol medicine for the rest of my life, or can I stop once it's normal?
translation: 我是不是一辈子都要吃胆固醇的药，还是等胆固醇正常了就可以停？

speaker: doctor
english: Are you allergic to any medicines, such as penicillin or aspirin?
translation: 您对什么药物过敏吗？比如盘尼西林或者阿司匹林？
translator_notes: 盘尼西林 (penicillin loanword) is the common term in Singapore; mainland standard is 青霉素.

speaker: doctor
english: Take one tablet three times a day after meals, and finish the whole course of antibiotics.
translation: 每次吃一粒，一天三次，饭后吃，而且要把整个疗程的抗生素吃完。
translator_notes: 粒 is the usual Singapore measure word for tablets.

speaker: doctor
english: This medicine may make you feel sleepy, so don't drive or operate machinery after taking it.
translation: 这个药可能会让您想睡觉，所以吃了以后不要开车，也不要操作机器。

speaker: patient
english: Can I take this medicine together with my blood pressure pills?
translation: 这个药可以和我的血压药一起吃吗？

speaker: patient
english: Can you give me a medical certificate for two days? My employer needs it.
translation: 您可以给我开两天的病假单吗？我的雇主需要。
translator_notes: 病假单 = MC as commonly called in Singapore.

speaker: patient
english: I'm 20 weeks pregnant. Is it safe for me to get the flu vaccine?
translation: 我怀孕20周了。我打流感疫苗安全吗？
translator_notes: Chinese has no grammatical gender here.

speaker: patient
english: I'm running out of my regular medicine. Can I get a refill without seeing the doctor?
translation: 我平时吃的药快吃完了。我可以不看医生，直接再拿药吗？
translator_notes: refill rendered as 再拿药 (get medicine again), the everyday phrasing.

speaker: doctor
english: If the fever doesn't go down in three days or you feel worse, please come back immediately.
translation: 如果三天内烧还没退，或者您觉得更不舒服，请马上回来。

speaker: doctor
english: I'll refer you to the hospital for an X-ray and a specialist review of your knee.
translation: 我会把您转介到医院，给您的膝盖照X光，并让专科医生检查。
translator_notes: 转介 is the Singapore term for referral; 照X光 for X-ray.

speaker: patient
english: I haven't been able to sleep well for a month, and I feel stressed and anxious all the time.
translation: 我已经有一个月睡不好了，而且总是觉得压力很大，很焦虑。

speaker: doctor
english: Try to cut down on sugar and salt, and exercise for at least 30 minutes most days.
translation: 尽量少吃糖和盐，并且大部分日子都运动至少30分钟。
